name: clotho
tagline: Digital Wardrobe & On-Device AI Outfit Studio

label: Values
paragraphs: clotho is a private, local-first digital wardrobe and interactive outfit studio designed to turn daily dressing into a mindful, creative ritual without uploading a single photo to the cloud.

featuring instant on-device AI background removal in 0.2s, a 7-slot interactive mannequin canvas, and a visual outfit calendar with style streaks, clotho gives you complete data sovereignty with zero trackers and zero cloud dependencies.

label: Mannequin Studio
subtitle: 7-slot interactive silhouette layering
caption: Audition layered outfits in real time across headwear, necklaces, tops, outerwear, bottoms, bags, and shoes with multi-layering support.

label: Digital Wardrobe
subtitle: Intelligent garment cataloging
caption: Filter and browse your digitized wardrobe by category, brand tags, color swatches, primary materials, and wear frequency counts.

label: Style Calendar
subtitle: Visual outfit diary & streaks
caption: Track daily looks with high-resolution collage snapshots, multi-outfit logging, and gamified style streaks to encourage intentional fashion.

label: AI Auto-Cut
subtitle: Instant background removal in 0.2s
caption: Snap or upload clothes on any surface; Clotho erases messy backgrounds directly on your device with interactive cutout refinement.

label: Garment Details
subtitle: Material, brand & wear analytics
caption: Detailed garment editor with wear frequency tracking, multi-season tags, material composition, and purchase history.

label: Minimalist Experience
subtitle: Dark & light mode with liquid glass aesthetic
caption: Fluid animations, crystalline Web Audio sound effects, haptic feedback, and offline Progressive Web App capability.

label: Official Web App
description: Launch the digital wardrobe and outfit studio directly in your browser at info.clotho.zinco.cc.

label: GitHub Repository
description: Explore the open-source Next.js 14 codebase, installable PWA configs, and issue tracker.

label: Documentation
description: Read full architecture documentation, feature deep dives, and data sovereignty philosophy.
